description: The "option pool shuffle" for one round: how much the pool must grow to hit a post-money target, the effective pre-money valuation, and how much founder ownership the pre-money pool costs versus adding it after the round. existing_pool_pct.description: Unissued pool today, percent of pre-round fully diluted shares.

founders_pct.description: Founders today, percent of pre-round fully diluted shares.

fully_diluted_shares.description: Fully diluted shares today. Optional; enables per-share outputs.

raise_usd.description: New money raised in the round.

target_pool_pct.description: Target unissued pool after the round, percent of post-money.
